items.title: Andrew Bailey Interview, 1959-09-30
items.q: Little fella called Sweetie. ... he don't play no more piano.

ctx.x: Do you know many of these piano players around that just played by themselves?
Well yeah I didn't know right smart of them. This is Virginia Pellibon. Little fella called Sweetie. And this mom I couldn't call their name but I know a very smart of piano players.
